name: npu-capacity
command:
env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c $'import json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/full-validation-rerun-20260731T064607Z/g0")
nodes=json.loads((root/"nodes.json").read_text())["items"]
pods=json.loads((root/"all-pods.json").read_text())["items"]
resource="huawei.com/Ascend910"
active={}
details=[]
for pod in pods:
    node=pod.get("spec",{}).get("nodeName"); phase=pod.get("status",{}).get("phase")
    if not node or phase in {"Succeeded","Failed"}: continue
    regular=sum(int(c.get("resources",{}).get("requests",{}).get(resource,"0")) for c in pod.get("spec",{}).get("containers",[]))
    init=max([int(c.get("resources",{}).get("requests",{}).get(resource,"0")) for c in pod.get("spec",{}).get("initContainers",[])]+[0])
    request=max(regular,init)
    if request:
        active[node]=active.get(node,0)+request
        details.append({"namespace":pod["metadata"]["namespace"],"name":pod["metadata"]["name"],"node":node,"phase":phase,"request":request})
result={}
for node in nodes:
    name=node["metadata"]["name"]; ready=any(c["type"]=="Ready" and c["status"]=="True" for c in node["status"].get("conditions",[])); alloc=int(node["status"].get("allocatable",{}).get(resource,"0")); used=active.get(name,0); result[name]={"ready":ready,"allocatable":alloc,"active_requests":used,"free":alloc-used if ready else 0}
assert result["n1"]["free"]>=2,result
print(json.dumps({"resource":resource,"required_on_n1":2,"nodes":result,"requesting_pods":details},sort_keys=True,indent=2))'

name: startup-assertions
command:
env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c $'import json,re
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/full-validation-rerun-20260731T064607Z/g0")
pods=json.loads((root/"ready-pods.json").read_text())["items"]
assert len(pods)==2
ready={}
for pod in pods:
    app=pod["metadata"]["labels"]["app"]
    status=pod["status"]["containerStatuses"][0]
    condition=next(c for c in pod["status"]["conditions"] if c["type"]=="Ready")
    assert app in {"prefill","decode"} and condition["status"]=="True" and status["ready"] and status["restartCount"]==0
    ready[app]={"pod":pod["metadata"]["name"],"image_id":status["imageID"]}
for role in ("prefill","decode"):
    log=(root/f"{role}-engine.log").read_text()
    assert "Application startup complete" in log and "Starting vLLM server" in log and "Creating v1 connector with name: AscendStoreConnector" in log
    assert "TypeError" not in log and "Traceback (most recent call last)" not in log
    assert "max_num_batched_tokens' is an invalid keyword argument" not in log
    process=(root/f"{role}-process-state.txt").read_text()
    assert "python3 -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server" in process
    models=json.loads((root/f"{role}-models.json").read_text())
    assert models["object"]=="list" and len(models["data"])==1 and models["data"][0]["id"]=="vllm-ascend/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-W8A8"
proxy=json.loads((root/"proxy-endpoints.json").read_text())
assert proxy["status"]=="ok" and len(proxy["prefill_nodes"])==1 and len(proxy["decode_nodes"])==1
assert (root/"proxy-health.txt").read_text().splitlines()[0]=="200"
metrics=(root/"master-running.metrics").read_text()
values={}
for name in ("master_key_count","master_allocated_bytes","master_active_clients"):
    match=re.search(rf"^{name} ([0-9.eE+-]+)$",metrics,re.M); assert match; values[name]=float(match.group(1))
assert values["master_key_count"]==0 and values["master_allocated_bytes"]==0 and values["master_active_clients"]>=2,values
print(json.dumps({"validated":True,"ready_pods":ready,"http_models":True,"proxy_prefill_nodes":1,"proxy_decode_nodes":1,"coordinator_type_error":False,"master_metrics":values},sort_keys=True,indent=2))'

name: artifact-assertions
command:
env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c $'import json,re
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("features/kv-pool-layerwise-reuse/evidence/full-validation-rerun-20260731T064607Z/g0")
steps=[json.loads(line) for line in (root/"steps.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
assert len(steps)==71,len(steps)
failures=[s for s in steps if s["exit_code"]!=0]
assert len(failures)==1 and failures[0]["name"]=="prefill-pod-yaml" and failures[0]["exit_code"]==1,failures
pre=json.loads((root/"prestart-identity-assertions.json").read_text()); start=json.loads((root/"startup-assertions.json").read_text())
assert pre["validated"] and start["validated"] and start["coordinator_type_error"] is False
assert start["proxy_prefill_nodes"]==1 and start["proxy_decode_nodes"]==1
assert start["master_metrics"]["master_active_clients"]>=2
for role in ("prefill","decode"):
    assert f"{role}_stopped=true" in (root/f"assert-{role}-stopped.txt").read_text()
    log=(root/f"{role}-engine.log").read_text()
    assert "Application startup complete" in log and "TypeError" not in log and "Traceback (most recent call last)" not in log
metrics=(root/"final-empty.metrics").read_text()
final={}
for name in ("master_key_count","master_allocated_bytes","master_active_clients"):
    match=re.search(rf"^{name} ([0-9.eE+-]+)$",metrics,re.M); assert match; final[name]=float(match.group(1)); assert final[name]==0,(name,final[name])
history=json.loads((root/"source-state.json").read_text())
assert history["head"]=="14beaf161cca6f1e044e20529ca96c6554dbbe50" and history["commit_count"]==11 and not history["merge_commits"] and not history["dirty"]
pods=json.loads((root/"final-pods.json").read_text())["items"]
by_app={p["metadata"].get("labels",{}).get("app"):p for p in pods}
for app in ("prefill","decode","mooncake-master","proxy"):
    assert by_app[app]["status"]["phase"]=="Running" and by_app[app]["status"]["containerStatuses"][0]["restartCount"]==0
print(json.dumps({"validated":True,"recorded_steps":len(steps),"superseded_nonzero_steps":failures,"prestart_identity":True,"prefill_ready":True,"decode_ready":True,"proxy_routing":True,"old_coordinator_type_error_reproduced":False,"engines_stopped":True,"master_reset":True,"final_metrics":final,"source_head":history["head"],"source_commits":history["commit_count"],"pods_retained":True},sort_keys=True,indent=2))'
